exceptions.rationale: python-ecdsa treats the timing side channel as out of scope and publishes no fixed version; Wright does not use the affected signing API for release signing.
exceptions.compensating_control: Release signing uses GitHub OIDC/Sigstore; application tokens are handled by python-jose verification paths and the secret provider.

exceptions.rationale: The upstream advisory has no patched React Router release. Wright is a browser-only SPA and does not enable React Server Components or React Router server actions, which are required for the affected request path.
exceptions.compensating_control: Wright routes client-side with BrowserRouter and sends mutations only through explicit Wright API calls. Security maintainers will update React Router when an upstream fixed release is available.
